title: System platform endpoint tool aggregation and exact dispatch

phases.objective: Expose one stable System Tool Catalog descriptor for shared platform endpoint exports and dispatch only the explicitly selected governed endpoint binding.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: System Tool Catalog normalization followed by grouped platform endpoint binding resolution
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One collision-free public descriptor is listed and exact endpoint selection succeeds while missing or invalid selectors fail closed.
steps: Load multiple active platform endpoint export rows that share one public tool name but preserve distinct endpoint schemas.
Aggregate only genuinely shared names into one deterministic descriptor with an endpoint_key enum and exact binding metadata.
Preserve each endpoint binding schema through System Tool Catalog normalization and retain the original schema for single-binding tools.
Regenerate the frontend dispatch evidence from the exact candidate head.
Resolve an allowed endpoint_key to its exact registry binding for runtime dispatch.
Enforce the grouped-dispatch runtime ratchet and reject selector regressions.
assertions: The public catalog contains exactly one descriptor for github_rest_endpoint_dispatch.
The endpoint selector enum is deterministic and contains every visible exported endpoint.
Per-endpoint input schemas remain discoverable after catalog normalization.
A single-binding export retains its original required fields and does not gain a required endpoint_key.
Catalog normalization does not throw SYSTEM_TOOL_DESCRIPTOR_NAME_COLLISION.
Generated frontend dispatch evidence is refreshed from the same candidate head.
Dispatch cannot select a different endpoint than the caller-authorized endpoint_key.
No export row is deleted, archived, or renamed.

phases.objective: No new operational scheduler or stateful background process is introduced by this catalog projection fix.
Preserve fail-closed behavior for invalid selector and residual ambiguity conditions.

e2e_journeys.actor: authenticated system-tool caller with malformed or unauthorized endpoint selection
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The resolver returns a typed bounded error without selecting or calling an unintended endpoint.
steps: Submit a grouped tool call without endpoint_key or with an endpoint outside the exported enum.
Validate optional parent_action_key against the selected endpoint binding.
Stop before runtime endpoint execution when selection is missing, invalid, mismatched, or ambiguous.
assertions: Missing endpoint_key is rejected for a multi-binding tool.
Unknown endpoint_key is rejected with the allowed enum in non-secret details.
No provider call or external write occurs during failed selection.

phases.objective: Verify the grouped descriptor against the live non-production System Tool Catalog after deployment.
Verify Production lists one grouped descriptor and dispatches a read-only selected endpoint with exact SHA readback.
